correctness.rationale: For pulse initial state |1><1| and an absorbing sink at site 3, the Lindblad integrated density M=-L^{-1}(|1><1|) has finite trace: no invariant nondecaying positive state exists under kappa>0 by support elimination. Reconstructed 9x9 complex Liouvillian numerically independently and verified T(gamma)=3gamma/2+(kappa^2+6)/(2kappa)+delta^2*kappa*(6gamma+kappa)/(2P), P=2kappa gamma^2+(kappa^2+8)gamma+2kappa, including gamma=0. Symbolically checked T(gamma)-T(0)=gamma(6P-delta^2 kappa S)/(4P), S=kappa^2+2kappa gamma-4, and T'= [3P^2-delta^2 kappa^2 Q]/(2P^2), Q=12gamma^2+4kappa gamma+kappa^2-4. The G(gamma)=6P/(kappa S) derivative has upward quadratic K with constant kappa^4-32; hence interior coexisting gamma_c only when kappa<32^(1/4). R'=12kappa Q on Q>0 proves a unique positive local minimum wherever it beats zero. Four independently constructed Liouvillian inverses and exact symbolic factor identities passed. At equality high kappa the unique minimizer remains zero; no thermodynamic transition claim.
